offers.title: National student rail discount
offers.description: National student fare on eligible routes and trains.
offers.eligibility: Students ages 17–24 with a valid student ID.
offers.how_to_redeem: Book at least one day ahead via Amtrak’s student offer page and carry your student ID.

offers.title: Uber One for Students
offers.description: Student pricing on Uber One, which covers eligible rides and Uber Eats orders.
offers.eligibility: Eligible students who pass Uber’s verification.
offers.how_to_redeem: Verify enrollment through Uber. This is a recurring membership.

offers.title: DashPass for Students
offers.description: Discounted DashPass membership for eligible students.
offers.eligibility: Students at eligible schools who meet DoorDash’s verification requirements.
offers.how_to_redeem: Select the student plan, verify eligibility, and check delivery minimums and fees before subscribing.

offers.title: Headspace Student Plan
offers.description: Discounted annual access to Headspace meditation and sleep content.
offers.eligibility: Verified students age 18 or older in an eligible post-secondary program.
offers.how_to_redeem: Sign up on the student plan page and verify enrollment.

offers.title: Dell Education Purchase Program
offers.description: Student savings on eligible items at Dell.
offers.eligibility: Eligible U.S. students, including full-time and part-time college students.
offers.how_to_redeem: Verify student status and shop eligible items through Dell.

offers.title: HP Education Store
offers.description: Education savings on participating HP products.
offers.eligibility: U.S. students and other eligible education groups.
offers.how_to_redeem: Register for the HP Education Program and check the price of eligible items at checkout.

offers.title: Ableton Live education discount
offers.description: Education pricing for eligible editions of Ableton Live.
offers.eligibility: Students who satisfy Ableton’s education license requirements.
offers.how_to_redeem: Choose an education license and follow Ableton’s proof-of-eligibility instructions.

offers.title: Pro Tools Studio for Education
offers.description: Annual education subscription for Pro Tools Studio.
offers.eligibility: Students at qualifying academic institutions who can verify their eligibility.
offers.how_to_redeem: Choose Studio for EDU and complete academic verification.

offers.title: Max student license
offers.description: Education pricing for qualifying first-time Max license purchases.
offers.eligibility: Eligible students as defined by Cycling ’74.
offers.how_to_redeem: Check the student license options and follow the verification instructions.

offers.title: Vineyard Vines student discount
offers.description: Vineyard Vines offers eligible students a discount code.
offers.eligibility: Students who pass SheerID verification.
offers.how_to_redeem: Use the merchant’s verification form and follow the instructions in the email.

offers.title: Peacock Premium student discount
offers.description: Discounted Peacock Premium subscription. Standard pricing applies after the offer period unless renewed or canceled.
offers.eligibility: Eligible students who verify status. Existing subscribers may need additional steps.
offers.how_to_redeem: Verify through Peacock and review renewal terms before subscribing.

offers.title: Disney+ and Hulu Student Bundle
offers.description: Discounted student bundle for Disney+ and Hulu.
offers.eligibility: Eligible college and graduate students who verify their enrollment.
offers.how_to_redeem: Use the student bundle sign-up and confirm the subscription terms.

offers.title: HBO Max student plan
offers.description: Student pricing on HBO Max Basic with Ads.
offers.eligibility: U.S. accredited college or university students age 18+ who verify with UNiDAYS.
offers.how_to_redeem: Start on HBO Max and complete UNiDAYS verification.

offers.title: Pandora Premium Student
offers.description: Reduced Pandora Premium rate for eligible students for up to four years.
offers.eligibility: U.S. residents age 18+ enrolled at an accredited U.S. higher education institution.
offers.how_to_redeem: Select the student subscription and complete enrollment verification.

offers.title: Spotify Premium Student
offers.description: Discounted Premium for eligible students for up to four years.
offers.eligibility: Eligible college or university students.
offers.how_to_redeem: Sign up with Spotify and reverify eligibility every 12 months.

offers.title: Figma Professional for Education
offers.description: Free access to an Education team on the Professional plan.
offers.eligibility: Eligible higher-education students who verify their education status.
offers.how_to_redeem: Apply with your school email and follow Figma’s verification flow.

offers.title: Autodesk Education software access
offers.description: Access to eligible Autodesk software for educational use.
offers.eligibility: Students at qualifying educational institutions who pass eligibility verification.
offers.how_to_redeem: Choose a product and apply for education access through Autodesk.

offers.title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
offers.description: A bundle of GitHub tools and partner benefits for eligible students. Partner terms vary.
offers.eligibility: Students who meet GitHub Education’s eligibility requirements.
offers.how_to_redeem: Apply through GitHub Education and claim individual benefits through the pack.

offers.title: Apple Education Store pricing
offers.description: Education pricing on eligible Apple products, including select Macs and iPads.
offers.eligibility: Eligible U.S. higher-education students and other groups listed by Apple.
offers.how_to_redeem: Open the U.S. Education Store to see eligible products and current prices.

offers.title: Notion Plus for students
offers.description: Education access to Notion Plus for a one-member workspace.
offers.eligibility: Eligible college or university students with a qualifying school email.
offers.how_to_redeem: Sign up with your school email and choose the Education Plan.

offers.title: Creative Cloud Pro student pricing
offers.description: Student pricing on Creative Cloud Pro. Check the introductory price and later billing rate.
offers.eligibility: Students who meet Adobe’s education eligibility requirements.
offers.how_to_redeem: Check Adobe’s student plans and review the annual commitment and renewal price.

offers.title: Crocs student discount
offers.description: Crocs offers student savings on qualifying purchases.
offers.eligibility: Students who qualify for Crocs’ ID.me discount.
offers.how_to_redeem: Use the student verification link and check which items qualify.

offers.title: Vans student discount
offers.description: Vans offers a discount on eligible purchases to eligible U.S. college students.
offers.eligibility: Full-time or part-time students at accredited U.S. colleges or universities.
offers.how_to_redeem: Check the student discount under Vans offers and verify through SheerID for online purchases.

offers.title: Lenovo education discount
offers.description: Student savings on eligible Lenovo purchases.
offers.eligibility: Students who can verify their status with Lenovo’s partner ID.me.
offers.how_to_redeem: Start at the Lenovo Education store and verify student status.

offers.title: Back Market student discount
offers.description: Annual discount on a qualifying purchase of refurbished tech.
offers.eligibility: Students enrolled in U.S. higher education who pass verification.
offers.how_to_redeem: Verify through the merchant’s SheerID form. Offer is limited to one use per eligible customer per year.

offers.title: BYU student transit pass
offers.description: Eligible BYU IDs include a UTA transit pass.
offers.eligibility: Eligible BYU students with a current BYU ID smartcard.
offers.how_to_redeem: Check UTA’s service coverage and tap your BYU ID as directed.

offers.title: Gymshark U.S. student discount
offers.description: Eligible students can get a U.S. Gymshark discount via Student Beans or UNiDAYS.
offers.eligibility: Verified students using a U.S. offer.
offers.how_to_redeem: Verify through one of Gymshark’s listed partners. Check exclusions and apply the code at checkout.

offers.title: ASICS student discount
offers.description: Discount on eligible full-price items through the ASICS student program.
offers.eligibility: Eligible U.S. or Puerto Rico residents with a OneASICS account and verified student status.
offers.how_to_redeem: Sign in to OneASICS, verify through SheerID, and check per-purchase and monthly limits.

offers.title: Levi’s U.S. student discount
offers.description: Student discount for qualifying purchases on the U.S. Levi’s site.
offers.eligibility: Students verified through UNiDAYS.
offers.how_to_redeem: Follow the student verification link and apply the offer to an eligible order.

offers.title: Allbirds student community offer
offers.description: Allbirds lists a student offer for its U.S. store.
offers.eligibility: Students who qualify under the Allbirds community offer terms.
offers.how_to_redeem: Choose the student offer and verify before checkout. Check eligible items on the offers page.

offers.title: Rothy’s student discount
offers.description: Student savings on an eligible pair of shoes.
offers.eligibility: Students who pass the verification described by Rothy’s.
offers.how_to_redeem: Start on Rothy’s discount page and review the exclusions for bags, accessories, and gift cards.

offers.title: Gopuff Student FAM membership
offers.description: Student pricing on Gopuff’s delivery membership where service is available.
offers.eligibility: College students who can verify a school email.
offers.how_to_redeem: Verify your .edu email and check delivery availability and membership terms.

offers.title: MLB and MiLB student tickets
offers.description: Participating Major and Minor League teams list student ticket offers.
offers.eligibility: Student eligibility and availability depend on the team and game.
offers.how_to_redeem: Choose a participating team and check local ticket dates and terms.

offers.title: Utah Jazz college student tickets
offers.description: Student ticket program for eligible Jazz regular-season home games.
offers.eligibility: Students at Utah colleges or universities with a qualifying school email.
offers.how_to_redeem: Use the college ticket page to verify your school email and check open games and seating.

offers.title: Free BYU library software classes
offers.description: Library training on tools from Adobe and Microsoft. Classes carry no university credit.
offers.eligibility: BYU students, faculty, or staff with a BYU ID.
offers.how_to_redeem: Open the library’s software training page to check availability and request a class.

offers.title: The Economist student subscription
offers.description: Student pricing on a digital subscription. Check the current rate and renewal terms.
offers.eligibility: Students who meet The Economist’s student verification requirements.
offers.how_to_redeem: Open the student subscription page and confirm eligibility and local pricing.
